items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: He used to call him Jimbo.

ctx.x: They were about the same age as you, weren't they? You were about all the same age.

Yeah, but they wasn't playing. Oh. There was less than. Now, Sidney, he'd follow around George Barquet. He was always around with George Barquet. Well, Jimmy, he knew, he'd just come up like that with it. He used to call him Jimbo.
What instrument did he play when you first know him?
